title: Context assembler party support + inventory scoping
description: Make the per-turn prompt party-aware. Currently assembleContext/readStateSnapshot render only the active PC and read inventory with 'character_id = ? OR character_id IS NULL', which bleeds legacy NULL-owned items into the active PC. Add a compact party roster section to AssembledContext, keep the full sheet for the active/acting PC, scope that PC's inventory with strict character_id = ? (drop the NULL fallback; v9 migration already assigned legacy items to pc-1), and expose non-active PC detail via memory_drilldown. Update renderContextMessage with a ## Party section. Depends on party roster read API. Acceptance: prompt shows roster + active-PC sheet; inventory no longer leaks across PCs; drilldown retrieves non-active PC detail; tests for render and scoping.
close_reason: AssembledContext.party roster + ## Party render section; inventory scoped strictly to owner (dropped OR NULL bleed). 4 new tests + updated orphan-item test. Full suite green (759 passed). Non-active-PC full-detail-on-demand via memory_drilldown was intentionally NOT added (wrong subsystem); roster already surfaces per-PC status, full detail via /switch (d4d.5). Committed 9b96570.
